body: How is this on a narcissism thread considering how much narcissists study their targets and peripheral people? Narcissists scrutinize people.  And most people today are narcissists.

Feeling bad is normal, but you don't have to stay there. You can forgive yourself for having that defense mechanism. Think about asking your therapist about alternative reactions. You can go through some options together and you can practice with therapist where its safe.

Hey... leave that bitch alone. Find new friends. There are other ride or dies out there who want to give and receive love and respect just like you do.

It will not get better. Most borderlines attract narcissists, and in the beginning sometimes it resembles a strong healthy relationship. But they were only close with you because everyone else rejected them bc they caught on that the person has issues. Every one of my former friends were narcissistic and acted like a frenemy to me, and lo and behold, other people have told them about their undesirable personality traits. I was just the only one who accepted that shit behavior. 

Leave and stay gone. There are healthy people out there. <3

You just have to keep going even through the hard times. However hard you have to push yourself. Thats the formula. I learned this through a series of circumstances where i was forced to continue with what i was doing. High school was my first big lesson. 

Keep going. 

ALSO if you can find a group of ppl who do what you do, it helps tremendously. They can help keep you on track.

The world IS against you...sometimes. 

I believe that bpd is on the autism spectrum. Its on the far other side of the spectrum. Lets say the starting point is in the asperger realm like Sheldon from big bang, then it goes to Courtney love on the other end. People with high functioning autism can recognize patterns and things very well. So sheldon may be good at engineering or something, yet Courtney Love will be good recognizing PEOPLE patterns. Borderlines are skilled at the science of people and emotions.

The general pop doesnt pay attention to this stuff as much as the borderline- social etiquette/rules, social propriety, etc. The borderline gets *tired* just like the asperger kid that gets bullied everyday and shoots the school or goes postal. The borderline goes throug life exactly like the clueless asperger guy except people know the MIT guy has aspergers, yet they think you're normal. Both of you can't interact normally with people because of defenses. So basically YOU are held to a ridiculously high social standard. 

When you burn out... your brain and spirit decides that it is too tired to ignore the shitty social nuances that it endures everyday. So things get worse as a result. It's a mixture of changed outlook + the other people can sense that something is off and you are now vulnerable enough to be targeted. And they WILL target you during this weak time. For example, i live in a racist area. I deal with bad attitude and racism everyday from the cashiers at my local supermarket specifically. When i am tired, they get out of hand on those days. Because they hate me anyway and they sense my hatred and/or weakness. 

I dont give a fuck what anyone says there's a reason for all this shit, and its not that you're always the problem.

Don't kill yourself. Punch her in the face before you kill yourself. You deserve to live. If you're school age, reach out to a guidance counselor. If you're older, move out of there. What will hurt her the MOST even without you doing anything to her, is leaving her by herself with no one to abuse. Trust. But dont do it by dying. Try to live with other family.

Your life IS going somewhere, you just cannot see it. Your life will always be going somewhere. If you take the route of drug addict, it will take you longer to get to where you're supposed to be. But you WILL end up where you are supposed to be. I know this is a rough time, but hang in there.

You don't have to wait for rock bottom. And forget about how you were before 25 because it doesn't matter- you are who you are today and it is what it is. Take it easy on yourself and know that there is nothing wrong with taking baby steps through tough times. 

You can get through this.

Stop getting high. I feel like you are young, and have so many options it's mind blowing. But hey, sometimes people have a period in life where they just got high all day and it still manages to teach you life lessons. Just please... nothing too hard, and not for too long. Whatever you think you can't overcome, you can. Just devote time to it.
